subject.title: fix(core): harden CLI lifecycle and suite isolation

question: Should strict manifests reject existing fixture retry counts above 10, or must current retry-count compatibility remain the default?
rationale: The hard limit changes the accepted configuration contract, and automated tests cannot determine whether that upgrade break is intentional product policy.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep existing retry counts valid by default and introduce a separate explicit strict policy only if bounded retries are required.

options.title: Adopt the hard limit
options.body: Cap retries at 10 and provide explicit upgrade documentation, diagnostics, and compatibility proof for affected manifests.

options.title: Split the patch
options.body: Land the lifecycle and suite-isolation fixes separately while deferring the retry policy until the contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep existing retry counts valid by default and introduce a separate explicit strict policy only if bounded retries are required.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently carrying this hardening work and are directly connected to the validation implementation.
